items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: started transcribing some of the tunes from Phil Woods’ albums

ctx.x: Yeah. We started doing all those charts. Sap wrote them all out. And then I started, myself and Dave Javonne, when he was with us, another saxophone player here in Buffalo, started transcribing some of the tunes from Phil Woods’ albums and we’d write out his solo and then give it to her to learn. And then we’d write them in three parts and then we’d have alto, tenor and vocal, and we’d play them; or we’d do just like John Dankworth and Cleo Laine, where you play the unison line with the scatted vocal.
